free_tier.stated: Anonymous transfer: 30 GB per shipment, free, 14 days, 30 downloads per recipient. Paid (40 CZK): 50 GB, 90 days, unlimited downloads. Registered 'úschovna+' adds 50 GB of permanent storage on top of unlimited 50 GB sends.

egress.terms: Not metered; the paid upsell is retention and download count, not bandwidth.

record.chaining: Allows 30 GB per shipment with 14-day expiration. Persistent storage options require paid tiers starting at 50 GB.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap 30 GB free / 50 GB paid. Retention 14 days free, 90 days paid. 30 downloads per recipient on free.
record.reliability_note: Clean and honest pricing page (0 Kč explicitly listed next to 40 Kč), long-running CZ service. Nowhere near the volume needed.

evidence.proved: 'Posílejte zdarma až 30 GB ... Zůstanou u nás online k vyzvednutí po dobu 14 dní', 'do 30 GB / 14 dní / 30x / 0 Kč', 'do 50 GB / 90 dní / NEOMEZENĚ / 40 Kč'
